request: Do task P3-18 in docs/PLAN-PHASE-3.md: 'Offline states, and a test that actually goes offline'. Follow docs/AGENT-WORKFLOW.md and read the docs in the task's Reads column (UX-PRINCIPLES.md section 7, ARCHITECTURE.md section Progressive enhancement and offline) before changing anything. A saved garden must work with no connection; a plant or a tile that is not cached says 'needs connection' rather than guessing; user-visible strings only in src/i18n/. Add a Playwright test that drives the app with the network cut. The work is done when the phase's acceptance criteria hold: npm run check, pwsh scripts/verify.ps1 and the Playwright suite (npm run test:e2e) each pass, as separate gates, as in CI.

plan.title: Add 'offline-unavailable' DataErrorCode and classify offline fetch failures
plan.action: Add a new value 'offline-unavailable' to the DataErrorCode union type in src/data/errors.ts. In src/data/http.ts (or its caller), when a fetch throws AND navigator.onLine is false, throw DataError with code 'offline-unavailable' instead of 'fetch-failed'. This lets components branch on the error code to render the distinct 'needs connection' state without parsing prose or checking navigator.onLine themselves.
plan.motivation: The data layer is the only place that fetches (ARCHITECTURE.md:94). Currently all network failures produce DataError('fetch-failed'), making it impossible for the UI to distinguish 'offline and not cached' from 'server error'. The errors.ts comment explicitly states the code field exists so UI can branch on it. Centralizing this in the data layer prevents duplicated offline-state logic across components.

plan.title: Refactor ResultsSection to tolerate per-shard failure and render 'needs connection' for uncached shards
plan.action: Replace the Promise.all over all catalogue shards in ResultsSection.tsx with per-shard error handling (Promise.allSettled or individual try/catch). Collect plants from successful shards into the results array. For each failed shard, render a 'needs connection' placeholder for the plants in that shard using the i18n key added in task 1. The component should branch on DataError.code === 'offline-unavailable' to show the specific offline message, and fall back to the generic loadError for other failure types. This is the most significant structural change: it enables partial rendering where cached plants show normally and uncached ones say 'needs connection'.
plan.motivation: ResultsSection.tsx:78-79 loads all shards with Promise.all; a single shard failure sets loadError=true and the entire results section shows a generic error. P3-18 requires per-item availability: 'a plant or a tile that is not cached says needs connection rather than guessing'. The current all-or-nothing pattern cannot express 'plant A loaded, plant B needs connection'.

plan.title: Write Playwright e2e test that drives the app with network cut
plan.action: Create e2e/offline.spec.ts using the production build on port 4173 (where the service worker is registered). The test must: (1) load the app online to populate SW caches and save a garden, (2) call context.setOffline(true), (3) reload and assert the saved garden renders fully with cached content, (4) attempt to view an uncached plant or tile and assert the 'needs connection' i18n string is visible, (5) verify no network requests are made for cached content. Follow the patterns of the existing e2e/serviceWorker.spec.ts. The test must use context.setOffline(true) (not just checking navigator.onLine) to simulate a real network failure.
plan.motivation: The task explicitly requires 'a test that actually goes offline' and 'Playwright drives it with the network cut, because an offline claim no one has tested offline is the kind of promise this repo does not make.' No such test exists. The service worker is registered in production only (port 4173), so the dev server cannot be used.
